id: title:DanielVisca:list service name once in project wide attribute keys

observations.behavior: Adds a subquery to group and distinguish between dotted (`service.name`) and underscored (`service_name`) attribute keys before aggregating counts.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the backend query for listing metric attributes; this could affect how warehouse ingestion or dashboard queries return distinct values when both key variants exist.

observations.behavior: Replaces two separate `SELECT` statements with one conditional aggregation using `if(has_dotted_service_name, 'service.name', 'service_name')`.
observations.posthog_connection: Consolidates duplicate rows into a single row per unique value while preserving the canonical key name, potentially changing result ordering and deduplication behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds tests asserting that synthetic and dotted resource labels are returned as a unified set without duplication. This checks implementation correctness rather than demonstrating broader systemic benefit.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks API responses against expected results but does not independently establish wider reliability or adoption benefits.

observations.limitations: The change is localized to warehouse metrics attribute retrieval and its test assertions. No release notes, WPRs, or tier-3 indicators are present in the chunk.

review.limitations: The change is localized to warehouse metrics attribute retrieval and its test assertions. No release notes, WPRs, or tier-3 indicators are present in the chunk.
review.reason: This hunk demonstrates a substantive bounded improvement: it unifies handling of duplicated warehouse keys and changes an existing query path. The accompanying tests check this specific behavior; no broader system-wide risk reduction or multi-component dependency is shown.
review.posthog_relevance: Could improve warehouse ingestion consistency and dashboard display when both underscored and dotted service names exist, though actual benefit depends on production configuration and user setup.
review.uncertainty: Without access to full repository context and runtime behavior, we cannot assess whether this resolves widespread duplicate-key issues or only edge cases.
